# Layout (Stack, Grid, Box, Container)

**Figma:** Auto layout + Spacing/Gap, Spacing/Padding, Corner-Radius variables  
**Import:** `import { Box, Container, Grid, Stack } from "@zen/design-system";`

Token-based layout primitives: Stack (one direction), Grid (columns), Box (padding, background layer, border, radius) and Container (page width and margin). They replace hand-written flex/grid CSS so spacing always comes from the Figma scale.

## Use it for
- Stacking sections, fields or cards (Stack, gap md–lg).
- Toolbars and button rows (Stack direction="row", align center, justify between).
- Card and tile grids that reflow (Grid minColumnWidth) or form columns (Grid columns={{ mobile: 1, desktop: 2 }}).
- Wells and plain panels (Box surface + padding).
- Page content width with the breakpoint margin (Container).

## Use something else for
- A clickable or selectable tile → Card.
- Rows of data → List/ListItem or Table.
- A modal or sheet surface → Dialog, SidePanel, BottomSheet.
- Separating groups with lines → Divider.

| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gap (Spacing/Gap) | `gap · rowGap · columnGap` | none · 3xs 2 · 2xs 4 · xs 8 · sm 12 · md 16 (default) · lg 24 · xl 32 · 2xl 40 · 3xl 48 · giant 64 · xgiant 88 · 2xgiant 144 (long names like small also work) |
| Padding (Spacing/Padding) | `padding · paddingX · paddingY` | 3xs 2 · 2xs 4 · xs 8 · sm 12 · md 16 · lg 20 · xl 24 · 2xl 32 · 3xl 40 · 4xl 48 |
| Direction / alignment | `direction · align · justify · wrap` | column (default) or row; start · center · end · stretch · baseline; between · around |
| Columns | `columns · minColumnWidth` | a number, a track list for unequal columns ("2fr 1fr"), per breakpoint { mobile, tablet, desktop }, or auto-fill at ≥ minColumnWidth (240 default) |
| Background layer | `surface (Box)` | surface · surface-alt · subtle · pale |
| Border | `border (Box)` | pale (static) · subtle (actionable) |
| Corner-Radius | `radius (Box)` | 2xs · xs · sm · md · lg · xl · 2xl · 3xl · full (follows the radius mode) |
| Width | `maxWidth (Container)` | sm 640 · md 960 · lg 1280 (default) · xl 1440 · full; gutter = page margin token |
| Sizing (Figma resizing) | `width · height · minWidth · maxWidth · minHeight · maxHeight · alignSelf (Stack, Grid, Box) · fillChildren (Stack)` | "hug" (Hug contents) · "fill" (Fill container: grows along the parent Stack's direction, stretches across it, 100% in a Grid cell or block) · a number = Fixed px; min/max in px; alignSelf start · center · end · stretch = the child's alignment in its Stack or Grid; fillChildren = every child takes an equal share (a column only when it has a height). Sizes include padding (border-box). maxWidth here is px; Container's maxWidth is a token width. Unset changes nothing |
| Position (Figma Ignore auto layout) | `position (Stack, Grid, Box)` | static (default, in flow) · absolute = out of the parent's flow, pinned to the parent Stack, Grid, Box or Card; siblings, gap and the parent's Hug ignore it, a later in-flow sibling paints above it |
| Constraints | `constraintX · constraintY` | read only with position="absolute": left (default) · right · left-right (stretches between the two insets, width ignored) · center (exact centre) × top (default) · bottom · top-bottom · center; Scale is not offered (it needs percentages) |
| Insets (Spacing/Padding) | `insetTop · insetRight · insetBottom · insetLeft` | none (default, flush) · 3xs 2 … 4xl 48, each read only on an edge its constraint pins; no negative insets (overhangs belong to components) |
| Effect style (Box) | `effectStyle` | the Figma effect style, one per box: Shadow/Bottom/Level-1…4 · Shadow/Top/Level-1…4 (drop shadows, only on surface="surface", no border; Level-1 = the Card and Sidebar elevation; Top casts upward for bottom-pinned bars) · Effect/Overlay (background blur, only on surface subtle or pale) |
| Clip content (Box) | `clip` | true clips children to the box and its corners (Figma Clip content), e.g. full-bleed absolute media in a radiused Box |
| Corner-Radius per corner | `radiusTopLeft · radiusTopRight · radiusBottomRight · radiusBottomLeft (Box, Image)` | the radius scale per corner, following the radius mode; a set corner wins over radius; write radius plus only the corners that differ (Image's radius defaults to md) |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/layout.json`.

### Stack
One-dimensional layout with token spacing. Use it instead of hand-written flex CSS. <Stack gap="lg">…sections…`</Stack>` <Stack direction="row" gap="sm" align="center" justify="between">…toolbar…`</Stack>`

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, LayoutSizingProps, LayoutPositionProps`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `"hug" \| "fill" \| number` | — | Horizontal resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual width. `"hug"` (Hug contents): as wide as its content, never grows or stretches. `"fill"` (Fill container): in a row Stack it takes an equal share of the space left after each child's padding and may shrink to 0; in a column Stack it stretches across; in a Grid cell or a plain block it takes the full width. Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap. A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box). (Container's `maxWidth` is a different prop: a token width, sm…full.) Prefer hug or fill; use Fixed only for widths that really are fixed (a side column, a preview frame). |
| `minWidth` | `number` | — | Minimum width in px (Figma min width). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0. |
| `maxWidth` | `number` | — | Maximum width in px (Figma max width), e.g. a readable line length for a Fill block of text. |
| `alignSelf` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end" \| "stretch"` | — | This element's alignment inside its parent: start · center · end · stretch across a Stack's direction (vertical in a row, horizontal in a column), vertical inside a Grid cell. Overrides the parent's `align` for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid. |
| `height` | `"hug" \| "fill" \| number` | — | Vertical resizing, as in Figma auto layout. Unset keeps the element's usual height. `"hug"` (Hug contents): as tall as its content, never grows or stretches. `"fill"` (Fill container): in a column Stack it takes an equal share of the free height; it shrinks below its content only when the column has a height of its own (Fixed, Fill or maxHeight), else it keeps its content height (pass `minHeight={0}` for a scrolling child of a column sized from outside). In a row Stack it stretches to the row's height; in a Grid cell it fills the cell (over alignSelf); in a plain block it takes 100% (the parent needs a height). A number: Fixed height in px, which does not shrink in a column Stack. |
| `minHeight` | `number` | — | Minimum height in px (Figma min height). Wins over fill's shrink-to-0. |
| `maxHeight` | `number` | — | Maximum height in px (Figma max height). |
| `position` | `"static" \| "absolute"` | — | Figma "Ignore auto layout" (layoutPositioning ABSOLUTE). `"absolute"` takes the element out of its parent's flow and pins it to the parent Stack, Grid, Box or Card with `constraintX` / `constraintY`; siblings, `gap`, `justify` and the parent's Hug size ignore it, as in Figma. Siblings written after it paint above it (Figma auto layout "Last on top"), so put background media first. Default `"static"` (in flow). Only Stack, Grid and Box take it: wrap a Text or a component in a Box. Badges, status dots and a Card sub-action are component props, never insets. |
| `constraintX` | `"left" \| "right" \| "left-right" \| "center"` | — | Figma horizontal constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `left` (default, Figma Left) · `right` (Right) · `left-right` (Left & right: stretches between the two offsets, `width` is ignored) · `center` (Center: exact centre, the X offsets are ignored). Figma Scale is not offered (it needs percentages, which are not tokens). |
| `constraintY` | `"top" \| "bottom" \| "top-bottom" \| "center"` | — | Figma vertical constraint, read only with `position="absolute"`: `top` (default) · `bottom` · `top-bottom` (Top & bottom: stretches between the two offsets, `height` is ignored) · `center` (exact centre). |
| `insetTop` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "4xl"` | — | Offset from the parent's top edge on Spacing/Padding (none 0 · 3xs 2 · 2xs 4 · xs 8 · sm 12 · md 16 · lg 20 · xl 24 · 2xl 32 · 3xl 40 · 4xl 48; Figma Y snapped to the padding ladder). Read only when `constraintY` pins the top edge (`top`, `top-bottom`). Default none (flush). Measured from the parent's padding box, as Figma ignores the frame's padding for absolute children. |
| `insetRight` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "4xl"` | — | Offset from the parent's right edge on Spacing/Padding. Read only when `constraintX` is `right` or `left-right`. Default none. |
| `insetBottom` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "4xl"` | — | Offset from the parent's bottom edge on Spacing/Padding. Read only when `constraintY` is `bottom` or `top-bottom`. Default none. |
| `insetLeft` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "4xl"` | — | Offset from the parent's left edge on Spacing/Padding (Figma X snapped to the ladder). Read only when `constraintX` is `left` or `left-right`. Default none. |
| `direction` | `"column" \| "row"` | `"column"` | column (default) stacks top to bottom; row lays items side by side. |
| `gap` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "giant" \| "xgiant" \| "2xgiant"` | `"md"` | Space between items (Figma Spacing/Gap). Default md (16px). |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end" \| "stretch" \| "baseline"` | — | Cross-axis alignment. Default: rows center their items; columns stretch fields, cards and lists to the full width while buttons, chips, badges, tags and avatars keep their own width (pass `align="stretch"` to stretch those too, e.g. full-width buttons in a mobile footer). |
| `justify` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end" \| "between" \| "around"` | — | Main-axis distribution. `between` pushes the first and last items to the edges. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | `false` | Let row items wrap onto new lines. |
| `fillChildren` | `boolean` | `false` | Every child takes an equal share along the direction (Figma: all children Fill container), for children that have no sizing props of their own (Button, Input, Card… but also a Divider or an Icon: wrap those in `<Box width="hug">`). A child's own `width` (row) or `height` (column) wins; in a row children keep their own minimum width (a Button never shrinks below its label). A column shares equally only when its height is Fixed or Fill (Buttons get taller); with only a maxHeight the children keep their content height and shrink once it caps; without a height they keep their content height. |
| `padding` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "4xl"` | — | Space inside the stack (Figma Spacing/Padding). |
| `paddingX` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "4xl"` | — | Horizontal padding (overrides `padding` on the sides). |
| `paddingY` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "4xl"` | — | Vertical padding (overrides `padding` top and bottom), e.g. page content inside a Container that already has side margins. |
| `as` | `"div" \| "section" \| "article" \| "aside" \| "header" \| "footer" \| "main" \| "nav" \| "form" \| "fieldset" \| "ul" \| "ol" \| "li"` | `"div"` |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — |  |

### Box
A plain container with token padding, background layer, border and radius. For clickable or selectable tiles use Card; for page width use Container.

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, LayoutSizingProps, LayoutPositionProps, BoxEffectProps, CornerRadiusProps`.

Fill children in a wrapping row need a `minWidth` to wrap. A number: Fixed width in px, which never shrinks in a flex row. Sizes include padding and border (border-box). Overrides the parent's `align` for this child. A `"fill"` size on the same axis still fills; in a column, alignSelf then places it once maxWidth stops it. No effect outside a Stack or Grid. |

In a row Stack it stretches to the row's height; in a Grid cell it fills the cell (over alignSelf); in a plain block it takes 100% (the parent needs a height). A set corner wins over `radius`, as `paddingX` wins over `padding`; unset corners keep `radius`. Don't mix `full` with a finite corner (`radius="full" radiusBottomRight="xs"`): `full` is Corner-Radius/Rounded (1000px), so the browser scales every corner down to fit the box and the small one renders square. Use a finite radius (a chat tail: `radius="xl" radiusBottomRight="xs"`); `full` mixes only with `none`. |
| `radiusTopRight` | `"none" \| Exclude<ZenScaleInput, "3xs" \| "3xsmall"> \| "full"` | — | Top-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma topRightRadius). Wins over `radius`. |
| `radiusBottomRight` | `"none" \| Exclude<ZenScaleInput, "3xs" \| "3xsmall"> \| "full"` | — | Bottom-right corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomRightRadius). Wins over `radius`. |
| `radiusBottomLeft` | `"none" \| Exclude<ZenScaleInput, "3xs" \| "3xsmall"> \| "full"` | — | Bottom-left corner on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma bottomLeftRadius). Wins over `radius`. |
| `padding` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "4xl"` | — |  |
| `paddingX` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "4xl"` | — |  |
| `paddingY` | `"none" \| ZenScaleInput \| "4xl"` | — |  |
| `surface` | `"none" \| "surface" \| "surface-alt" \| "subtle" \| "pale"` | `"none"` | Background layer (docs/guidelines/background-layers.md): `surface` for cards and panels on the Canvas page, `surface-alt` on a white (Alt) canvas, `subtle` / `pale` for wells. Never Canvas (the page), Flat (navigation) or Container (modals and sheets use Dialog / BottomSheet). |
| `border` | `"none" \| "pale" \| "subtle"` | `"none"` | Closed-box border: `subtle` when the box is actionable, `pale` when it is static (docs/guidelines/borders.md). |
| `radius` | `"none" \| Exclude<ZenScaleInput, "3xs" \| "3xsmall"> \| "full"` | — | Corner radius on the Corner-Radius tokens (Figma cornerRadius, follows the radius mode); `radiusTopLeft` … `radiusBottomLeft` override single corners. |
| `as` | `"div" \| "section" \| "article" \| "aside" \| "header" \| "footer" \| "main" \| "nav" \| "form" \| "fieldset" \| "ul" \| "ol" \| "li"` | `"div"` |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — |  |

### Container
Centres page content at a readable width with the breakpoint's page margin.

Also accepts `HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `maxWidth` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| "full"` | `"lg"` | Content width: sm 640 (forms) · md 960 (settings, reading) · lg 1280 (dashboards, default) · xl 1440 · full (list and table pages: a page whose content is a non-widget Table spans the whole width, no max). |
| `gutter` | `boolean` | `true` | Page margin on both sides from the breakpoint tokens (24 desktop/tablet, 20 mobile). Default true. |
| `as` | `"div" \| "section" \| "article" \| "aside" \| "header" \| "footer" \| "main" \| "nav" \| "form" \| "fieldset" \| "ul" \| "ol" \| "li"` | `"div"` |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — |  |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
type GridTracks = number | string
type ZenScale = "3xs" | "2xs" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl" | "3xl"
type ZenScaleInput = ZenScale | ZenScaleLong
type ZenScaleLong = "3xsmall" | "2xsmall" | "xsmall" | "small" | "medium" | "large" | "xlarge" | "2xlarge" | "3xlarge"
```

## ✅ Do
- Build page structure with Stack and Grid and pick the gap by the relationship, the same step everywhere (docs/component-usage-rules.md §13): 2xs inside one inline item, xs a thing and its label or a toolbar row, sm a group of Buttons or choices, md blocks inside one surface and stacked form fields, lg columns and groups inside a surface, xl page sections (Figma Master-Layout).
- Step up one level at least between groups: the gap between groups is always larger than the gap inside them.
- Use Stack direction="row" with justify="between" for a title + actions row.
- Use Grid minColumnWidth for card grids so they reflow from phone to desktop.
- Put a main column next to an aside with Grid columns={{ mobile: 1, desktop: "2fr 1fr" }} align="start"; on phones the aside moves under the main column.
- Put page content in a Container so its margin follows the breakpoint.
- Give a Box a surface only when it really is a separate layer; a Surface box on a white (Alt) canvas needs border="pale".
- Size like Figma auto layout: Hug for content-sized pieces, Fill for what takes the rest of a row or the full width (a main column; a Search next to buttons goes in a Box width="fill", since Search has no sizing props), maxWidth to cap a Fill line of text; use Fixed (a number) only for widths that really are fixed, such as a side column or a preview frame.
- Pin a media overlay with position="absolute" and a constraint on token insets: a corner action on a photo is constraintX="right" insetRight="sm" constraintY="top" insetTop="sm"; a caption bar is constraintX="left-right" constraintY="bottom".
- Put background media first and the content after it: the media is absolute (left-right × top-bottom), and the later in-flow content paints above it (Figma auto layout "Last on top").
- Lift a Surface panel on Canvas/Default with effectStyle="Shadow/Bottom/Level-1" and no border: elevation follows the Sidebar, and it is the Card shadow.
- Round only the top corners of top media to the container radius (radiusTopLeft and radiusTopRight), or clip the container; write radius plus only the corners that differ.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't write display:flex / gap: 13px CSS for layout; use Stack/Grid and the scale.
- Don't fix widths and heights in px to make a layout look right at one screen size; Hug and Fill reflow, Fixed does not (and a Fixed child never shrinks in a row).
- Don't space the same relationship differently on different screens, or override a component's own padding or gap.
- Don't make a Box clickable; clickable tiles are Card (or a Box with border="subtle" and role="button") (harness: box/border-matches-action).
- Don't paint Canvas, Flat or Container on a Box: Canvas is the page, Flat is navigation, Container is modals and sheets.
- Don't nest Containers.
- Don't use position="absolute" for what gap, justify or alignSelf can do: an absolute layer leaves the flow and no longer reflows with its siblings.
- Don't place status dots, badges or Card sub-actions by hand with absolute layers; they are component props (Avatar status, BadgeCounter, Card subAction).
- Don't put a shadow on a tinted fill (Subtle, Pale, Surface-Alt) or on a Canvas/Alt page; there a closed border separates the box.
- Don't write style={{ top }} or raw top/right/bottom/left/inset CSS in examples and templates; pin the layer with position, constraints and token insets (style-guard: position/token).
- Don't mix radius="full" with a finite corner (radius="full" radiusBottomRight="xs"): full is 1000px, so the browser scales every corner down to fit and the small corner renders square. Use a finite radius (radius="xl" radiusBottomRight="xs"); full mixes only with none (harness: radius/full-mixed).

## Accessibility
- Pick the element with `as` (nav, section, ul, form…) so landmarks and lists stay semantic; Stack/Grid as="ul" need li children.
- Layout never changes the reading order: keep DOM order = visual order (no CSS order tricks).

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `box/border-matches-action` | warn | A Box border follows the border rule: subtle only when the box is actionable (onClick, href, role=button), pale when it is static. | `zen-allow-box-border: <reason>` |
| `layout/constraint-needs-absolute` | warn | constraintX, constraintY and insetTop/Right/Bottom/Left are read only with position="absolute" (Figma: constraints apply once a layer ignores auto layout). | `zen-allow-constraint-in-flow: <reason>` |
| `layout/inset-not-read` | warn | An inset offsets only an edge its constraint pins: insetLeft with left or left-right, insetRight with right or left-right, insetTop with top or top-bottom, insetBottom with bottom or top-bottom (center reads none). | `zen-allow-inset-not-read: <reason>` |
| `layout/absolute-fill` | error | An absolute layer has no Fill: stretch it by pinning both edges (constraintX="left-right", constraintY="top-bottom"). | `zen-allow-absolute-fill: <reason>` |
| `layout/stretch-ignores-size` | warn | A layer pinned left and right takes its width from the two insets, and one pinned top and bottom its height: width or height is ignored there. | `zen-allow-stretch-size: <reason>` |
| `layout/absolute-align-self` | warn | alignSelf (Figma: align in parent) places an in-flow child; an absolute layer is placed by its constraints. | `zen-allow-absolute-align: <reason>` |
| `layout/absolute-parent` | warn | An absolute layer sits right inside a Stack, Grid, Box or Card, the frame its constraints measure from. | `zen-allow-absolute-parent: <reason>` |
| `box/effect-needs-surface` | error | A Shadow/Bottom|Top/Level-N effect style renders only on surface="surface": never on Subtle, Pale or Surface-Alt (§9), and a box without a fill has nothing to cast it. | `zen-allow-tinted-shadow: <reason>` |
| `box/blur-needs-tint` | warn | Effect/Overlay (background blur) shows only through a translucent fill: surface="subtle" or "pale". | `zen-allow-blur-on-opaque: <reason>` |
| `box/shadow-no-border` | warn | Elevation follows the Sidebar: a Box with a drop-shadow effect style takes no border (a bordered box takes no shadow). | `zen-allow-elevation: <reason>` |
| `radius/redundant-corners` | warn | Write radius alone when the corners match, and set radiusTopLeft/TopRight/BottomRight/BottomLeft only where they differ from radius (Image's radius defaults to md). | `zen-allow-redundant-corners: <reason>` |
| `radius/full-mixed` | warn | radius="full" takes no finite corner (radiusTopLeft/TopRight/BottomRight/BottomLeft other than full or none): use one token for all corners, or a finite radius with corner overrides. | `zen-allow-full-mixed: <reason>` |
| `layout/use-stack` | warn | Arrange children with Stack or Grid (gap, padding and columns come from spacing tokens), not a div with an inline flex/grid style. (App mode only.) | `zen-allow-raw-layout: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
